name: Hero Illustration
description: LinkedIn's homepage features a large right-side decorative illustration (person at laptop) that creates visual warmth. We have no hero illustration.

name: Google/Social Auth
description: LinkedIn prominently offers 'Continue with Google' OAuth. We have no social auth entry point.

name: Legal / Terms copy
description: LinkedIn shows consent text ('By clicking Continue… you agree to LinkedIn's User Agreement, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy') below auth CTAs. We have no equivalent.

name: Secondary content discovery section

name: OAuth / Social Sign-in

name: Content Discovery Band
description: LinkedIn has a full-width section below the hero with curated topic categories (Career, Productivity, Finance…). We jump straight to job listings with no discovery layer.

description: LinkedIn nav items pair an icon with a text label, making the nav scannable and visually rich. Ours is plain text only.

name: OAuth / social sign-in buttons

name: Social sign-in
